description: This PHP source file defines an abstract base class 'EndpointIntegrationTestCase' for implementing integration tests related to API endpoints within the OrangeHRM project. It provides utility methods for fixtures loading, test case management, mocking, and assertions tailored for endpoint testing scenarios.

classes.name: EndpointIntegrationTestCase
classes.description: An abstract PHPUnit test base class providing utility functions for testing API endpoints in the OrangeHRM system, including fixture setup, test case retrieval, mocking, and validation.

methods.name: populateFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixtures into the entity manager from specified fixture files, with optional fixture directory and cache reset.

methods.name: getTestCases
methods.description: Loads test case parameters from fixture files based on provided test case key and optional directory.

methods.name: getApiEndpointMock
methods.description: Creates a mock of the API endpoint class with specified test case parameters.

methods.name: assertValidTestCase
methods.description: Validates that a test case for a specific endpoint operation passes validation and produces the expected results.

methods.name: registerServices
methods.description: Registers specified services and factories into the dependency container for testing.

methods.name: getMockAuthUser
methods.description: Creates a mock user object with predefined user ID, employee number, and role based on test case parameters.

methods.name: registerMockDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Replaces the DateTimeHelperService with a mock providing a fixed 'now' time if specified.
